company.name: Monday.com
company.one_liner: Work management platform with AI agents

title: Monday.com: first look

claims.text: Monday.com is a B2B SaaS company, a sector Accel lists among its most represented areas.
The company sells a cloud-based work operating system where teams and AI agents collaborate, which matches Accel's AI and cloud/SaaS focus.
Its website highlights AI agents, an agent builder, and an AI workspace as core products.
Accel's website lists AI agents and agentic economy as a theme in its investing focus.
Accel's website says AI and B2B SaaS are among the most represented areas of its listed portfolio.
Monday.com served over 225,000 customers across more than 200 industries as of December 31, 2023.
Accel's portfolio includes Ironclad, a B2B SaaS contract management company that also uses AI, a similar product category.
Monday.com is a mature public company with a filed 20-F and F-3ASR, so it is well outside Accel's seed-to-Series A stage focus for new investments.
The dataset gives no stage, funding amount, or round history, so the stage estimate of Series C or later is unverified.
Its 2021 SEC filing names competitors including Asana, Wrike, Smartsheet, Notion, and Zendesk, showing a crowded work management market.
The Ironclad comparison is based only on a shared B2B SaaS sector and AI use, not on any stated relationship or deal.
The company's own materials describe its platform and agent products but do not confirm revenue, growth, or unit economics.
